sources.description: The uploader identifies this as a recording of a person snoring while asleep.
sources.preview: Public HQ MP3 preview, not the original lossless upload.
sources.master_conversion: Full HQ MP3 preview decoded, stereo averaged to mono where applicable, then resampled to 24000 Hz with normalized 256-tap rational-phase Kaiser sinc (radius 128, beta 8.6, 10800 Hz cutoff, reflect padding). Gain normalizes the complete master peak to 0.8. Original speed and pitch retained.

sources.author: mffm
sources.title: human snore.wav
sources.description: The uploader documented an adult snoring with a Zoom H4n field recorder.
sources.preview: Public HQ MP3 preview, not the original lossless upload.
sources.master_conversion: Full HQ MP3 preview decoded, stereo averaged to mono where applicable, then resampled to 24000 Hz with normalized 256-tap rational-phase Kaiser sinc (radius 128, beta 8.6, 10800 Hz cutoff, reflect padding). Gain normalizes the complete master peak to 0.8. Original speed and pitch retained.

processing: Three separate snore events from two real sleeping-person recordings. Trim, DC removal, gentle high/low-pass filtering, short edge fades, small silence margins and gain toward each former RMS with its former peak as a ceiling. No synthesis, pitch shifting, time stretching, extra reverberation or denoising.
